title: Add a PDF download button on Internet Archive
question: How do I download a book from the Internet Archive as a PDF?
answer: On a public book's page, open the Download Options box in the right-hand column and click PDF. Books you can only borrow have no PDF there. The usermods script on this page copies that PDF link into a Download PDF button under the book's title, so you don't have to scroll to the download list. It adds nothing on items without a public PDF, and it changes nothing else on the page.
prompt: Add a Download PDF button under the title on Internet Archive book pages.
details: The script reads the PDF link that archive.org already puts in **Download Options** and adds a button with the same address under the title. When an item has several PDFs (for example a black-and-white copy), it picks the one labelled plain "PDF". Borrow-only books have no PDF in that list, so the script adds nothing on them; it does not get around lending.

alternatives.title: Download Options
alternatives.body: Scroll down the right-hand column of the item page to **Download Options** and click **PDF**. **Show all** lists every file in the item.

alternatives.title: Direct URL
alternatives.body: Public items serve their files at `https://archive.org/download/<identifier>/`, where the identifier is the last part of the `/details/` address. That page lists every file, PDFs included.

check.expect: (() => { const b = document.getElementById('usermods-pdf-download'); const box = document.querySelector('.item-download-options'); return !!b && !!box && b.checkVisibility() && b.href === 'https://archive.org/download/alicesadventures00carr/alicesadventures00carr.pdf' && b.getBoundingClientRect().top < window.innerHeight && b.getBoundingClientRect().top < box.getBoundingClientRect().top; })()
check.intact: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('h1.item-title'); const box = document.querySelector('.item-download-options'); const theatre = document.querySelector('#theatre-ia'); return [t, box, theatre].every((e) => e && e.checkVisibility()); })()
